requiredActions.evidenceDescription: Durable reference to the App Store Connect app record showing the production bundle identifier.
Durable reference confirming English and Arabic metadata was reconciled from the approved submission bundle.
Durable reference confirming App Privacy answers match the approved source-controlled disclosure manifest.
Durable reference confirming the App Store age-rating questionnaire was completed and reviewed.
Durable reference confirming launch countries, availability, pricing and distribution settings.
Durable reference confirming review contact details and reviewer credentials were entered only in App Store Connect.
Durable reference to the production-candidate TestFlight build and completed private-testing evidence.
Durable reference to the Play Console app record showing the production package name.
Durable reference confirming English and Arabic store listing metadata was reconciled from the approved submission bundle.
Durable reference confirming Data safety answers match the approved source-controlled disclosure manifest.
Durable reference confirming the Play content-rating questionnaire was completed and reviewed.
Durable reference confirming launch countries, availability, pricing and distribution settings.
Durable reference confirming app-access instructions and reviewer credentials were entered only in Play Console.
Durable reference to the production-candidate internal/closed testing build and completed private-testing evidence.

completionRule: Every required action must be approved with a non-empty evidenceReference and approvedAt timestamp before store_console_configuration may be approved in submission-evidence.json.
secretBoundary: Never place store passwords, reviewer passwords, API keys, signing material, recovery codes or private credentials in this file, GitHub issues, pull requests, workflow artifacts or repository history.
